head_commit.message:
Raster gate: slug the artifact label so composed families can keep their receipts (#221)

An artifact name may not contain a colon, and composed-treatment family ids
are full of them. Six of twenty-four family jobs in run 33574304514 rendered
correctly and then failed at artifact upload for that reason alone, which
reads as a failed verdict when nothing about the packet failed — and a failed
job cannot honestly carry a RASTER_PASS.

GitHub Actions expressions have no replace(), so the label is computed in a
step and passed through the environment rather than interpolated into shell
source. The family id is untouched; only the artifact label is slugged.

One file, 14 insertions, 1 deletion. No packet file, ledger, queue, receipt,
application code, migration or other workflow; permissions unchanged at
contents: read; the gate still requires a hash-bound RASTER_PASS.
